chunks: Wahb ibn Wahb narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, that he used to say:
If an umm al-walad kills her master by mistake, then she is free and there is no liability upon her. But if she kills him intentionally, she is to be executed for him.

key_terms.أُمُّ الْوَلَدِ: A slave woman who has borne a child to her master
key_terms.قُتِلَتْ بِهِ: She is executed in retaliation for killing him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if an umm al-walad kills her master by mistake or intentionally?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning an umm al-walad who kills her master, distinguishing between accidental and intentional killing. It states that in the case of mistake she becomes free and bears no further liability, whereas in the case of deliberate killing, qiṣāṣ is applied against her.
